description.value: Beaumont Family Estate Winery is a family-run boutique winery at the foot of Boucherie Mountain in West Kelowna, producing 100% certified-organic estate wines since 1995 across 36 acres of vineyards. The Lubchynski family crafts small-batch wines including Pinot Noir, Gamay Noir, skin-contact Pinot Gris, and icewine, with daughter Alana serving as winemaker after working vintages in Australia, New Zealand, and Europe. Cyclists on the Okanagan wine route can stop in for a tasting, pick up bottles to go, and take in 360-degree views of the surrounding mountain valley and lake.

address.value: 2775 Boucherie Road, West Kelowna, BC V1Z 1N3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active boutique estate winery with a tasting room and online wine shop at 2775 Boucherie Road, West Kelowna; the contact page explicitly mentions wine pick-up ordering, confirming takeout availability. No bike-specific amenities (racks, pump, e-bike charging, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the site — the only outdoor fixture noted is a dog hitch and water bowl outside the shop. Phone and street address match OSM, though the website inconsistently uses two postal codes (V1Z 1N3 on most pages, V1Z 2G4 on the contact page) and sometimes labels the city as 'Kelowna' rather than 'West Kelowna'.
concerns: Website shows inconsistent postal codes: most pages list V1Z 1N3, but the contact page lists V1Z 2G4 — OSM uses no postal code so cannot cross-check.
Website inconsistently labels the city as 'West Kelowna' (most pages and footer) vs 'Kelowna' (some footer and contact instances); OSM 'West Kelowna' is correct as it is a distinct municipality.
Icewine Pinot Noir product page (/shop/icewine-pinot-noir-375) contains Lorem Ipsum placeholder text, indicating incomplete website content in at least one area.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, active winery with a public tasting room and wine shop on a popular Okanagan cycling corridor; a worthwhile stop for touring cyclists seeking certified-organic local wine.
